reason: V001 specified equal ceilings but omitted actual attempt, effort, token and independent-context accounting. V001 remains unchanged; no previous result is rescored as a V002 comparison.
inputs: Identical eligible seed/memory pool and knowledge cutoff. Forge intentionally receives neither seed nor memory; Radar receives seeds; Gap receives memory; Plain receives both. These differences define the experimental conditions; actual input usage is reported.
generation: Freeze exact prompts before any result. Bind one model, provider and sampling settings for all 12 requests before any invocation. Every invocation is a new stateless context with no previous generated cards, even within a condition. Do not use archived examples. One response per request, no repair calls, retries, best-of sampling, silent substitution or replacement of failed attempts. Failed and abandoned attempts consume their slot. Record server usage or UNKNOWN, human minutes, wall seconds and an operator context attestation for each attempt.
accounting: Report actual reserved/completed/valid/failed attempts, per-attempt and total known tokens with unknown-entry counts, actual human and wall effort, model/settings differences and missing context attestations. Equal ceilings do not establish equal actual effort. Actual token/time differences within common caps are descriptive, not a reason to equalise results after generation. Missing usage/effort leaves budget compliance UNKNOWN and comparative eligibility false. Actual excess, mixed models/settings or reused contexts is a protocol deviation. No prorating or retroactive budget changes.
reviews: Use all 24 original version-one cards in common format; no shortlist or repaired cards. A human independent of generation judges coherence, falsifiability, research worthiness and evidence integrity. Keep unknown labels. Review without condition/model metadata or key; content can reveal lanes, so blinding is partial procedural. Same-owner operation/review is a declared limitation. Record all review minutes; no inferred labels. Mechanism diversity needs a separate human comparison of economic transmission, affected roles and decisive measurements, not a family-label count.
analysis: Descriptive dimensions separately; no composite quality score, adaptive ranker, significance, economic validation, novelty or investment claim. Invalid/incomplete conditions remain visible. Source access and scientific novelty are NOT_CHECKED unless independently assessed with evidence under separate authority. READY is a proposal, never M/H.
